The Issuer hereby confirms that it has notified Fitch Ratings Ltd. ("Fitch") that it has discontinued the engagement of Fitch as one of its external credit rating agencies providing ratings on the Notes.

The discontinuance follows an internal review of the resource demands and costs involved in supporting a third rating. The Issuer will continue to maintain its ratings coverage from S&P Global Rating Europe Limited and Moody's Investor Services Limited.

Should you have any queries concerning the information contained in this notice please contact: Justin Turner, Company Secretary, Canary Wharf Finance II plc, One Canada Square, Canary Wharf, London E14 5AB. Email: ir@cwg.com.
